name: Morris Plains Recreation Summer Camp
description_short: Five week half day borough camp, 9 to noon, open only to Morris Plains resident families. Super Kids Camp (entering K to 5) meets at the Community Center with games, art and crafts, pool days and a talent show; Teen Camp (entering 6 to 9) meets at the Teen Center with optional bus trips.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Five week camp, 9 to noon, for resident children entering K to 9; residency means the family lives in a home paying Morris Plains property tax. Super Kids Camp (K to 5) and Teen Camp (6 to 9 at the Teen Center). Early drop off from 8 for K to 5. Address and phone are the Morris Plains Community Center, from the Contact Us section. Ages derived from grades, not stated.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 flyer: K to 5 camp and Teen Camp both June 29 to July 31, 9 to 12, closed July 3; fee $375 each ($475 after May 11). Early drop off $150. Teen trips $215 for all eight. Residents only, so there is no non-resident rate. Afternoon enhancement classes ($80 to $260) are separate.

source.title: Summer Camp & Enhancement Programs | Borough of Morris Plains, NJ

unknowns: Exact address of the Teen Center

for_andrew: Residents only: the camp is open only to families paying Morris Plains property tax, so the one posted rate ($375 for five weeks) is recorded. Andrew to decide whether a residents-only camp is listed.

Super Kids Camp (K to 5) and Teen Camp (6 to 9) share dates but meet at different buildings; drafted as one listing. The web page says K to 5 meet at Community Park, the 2026 flyer says the Community Center; the Community Center address is used.
